OpenAI poaches a Claude Code co-developer from Anthropic. Catherine Wu, who led product for Claude Code at Anthropic, is joining OpenAI to run product management for "Core Products," a hire that underscores the fierce competition between the two companies, which plays out not just at the model level but across pricing, product strategy, and talent. Codex and ChatGPT head Thibault Sottiaux welcomed her with a one-word quip: "CatGPT."

Wu says she wants to build agents that take work off users' plates while keeping them in control. By her own account, she joined Anthropic two years ago, when Claude Code was still a small internal tool and most users approved every permission request by hand. Today, the default is to trust Claude's judgment, and Claude handles large migrations and builds new products, Wu says.

Growth marketing manager Austin Lau is also moving from Anthropic to OpenAI. Beyond those two, Anthropic has recently lost skills and context engineer Thariq Shihipar and Anthony Morris, who built Claude Code Desktop, though neither has gone to OpenAI, at least not yet.

translation.html:
OpenAI 从 Anthropic 挖走一位 Claude Code 联合开发者。曾在 Anthropic 负责 Claude Code 产品工作的 Catherine Wu 将加入 OpenAI，领导“Core Products”的产品管理工作。这次招聘凸显了两家公司之间的激烈竞争，竞争不仅体现在模型层面，还涉及定价、产品战略和人才。Codex 和 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 用一个词打趣地欢迎她：“CatGPT。”

Wu 表示，她希望打造能够替用户分担工作、同时让用户保有控制权的智能体。据她自述，她两年前加入 Anthropic 时，Claude Code 还只是一个小型内部工具，大多数用户都要手动批准每一次权限请求。Wu 说，如今默认做法是信任 Claude 的判断，而 Claude 已能处理大规模迁移并构建新产品。

增长营销经理 Austin Lau 也将从 Anthropic 转投 OpenAI。除了这两人，Anthropic 最近还流失了技能与上下文工程师 Thariq Shihipar，以及打造了 Claude Code Desktop 的 Anthony Morris，不过这两人都没有加入 OpenAI，至少目前还没有。
